description: This file defines the SocketPort class and related socket handling classes within the Thunder::Core namespace, including socket types, states, and methods for managing socket connections, data transmission, and socket listening.

classes.name: SocketPort
classes.description: Represents a generic socket port with methods for socket management, data transmission, and state handling.

classes.name: SocketStream
classes.description: Derived from SocketPort, represents a stream socket.

classes.name: SocketDatagram
classes.description: Derived from SocketPort, represents a datagram socket.

classes.name: SocketListner
classes.description: Manages listening sockets and accepts incoming connections, with an internal Handler class for socket events.

classes.name: SocketListner::Handler
classes.description: Internal class handling socket events for the listener, including accepting new connections.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the socket.

methods.name: RemoteNode
methods.description: Sets the remote node for the socket.

methods.name: IsListening
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in listening state.

methods.name: IsConnecting
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in connecting state.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket is suspended.

methods.name: IsForcedClosing
methods.description: Checks if the socket is being forcibly closed.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has an error.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote node ID as string.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local node ID as string.

methods.name: ReceivedNode
methods.description: Returns the node ID of the last received message.

methods.name: SocketSendBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket send buffer size.

methods.name: SocketReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket receive buffer size.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Gets or sets the Time To Live value.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket with optional specific interface.

methods.name: Accept (overload)
methods.description: Accepts a connection and retrieves remote node ID.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Generates an identifier string for a node.

methods.name: SocketMode
methods.description: Determines socket mode based on type.
